Seattle and Eastside homes

Design-build remodeling from Seattle to the Eastside.

RT Signature Homes serves qualifying projects across Seattle and Eastside communities from its Redmond base. Planning responds to dense urban properties, established neighborhoods, varied housing stock, and jurisdiction-specific review.

Check project fit Explore available services
Call (206) 407-6291

How service is evaluated

The Seattle and Eastside operating area combines proximity to Redmond with project-specific planning for access, permitting, weather protection, and occupied homes.

What homeowners can expect

  • Redmond-based project coordination
  • Planning for several municipal review systems
  • Experience with established homes and constrained sites
  • Full interior, exterior, addition, ADU, and custom-home services

Available scopes

Services available in Seattle & the Eastside

Explore the services most relevant to the market, then use the consultation form to confirm fit for the property and scope.

whole-home remodeling

Whole-Home Remodeling

This service is designed for homeowners changing several rooms, reorganizing the floor plan, modernizing major systems, or preparing a home for its next chapter.

Explore service

Kitchen Remodeling

A strong fit includes full kitchen renovations, layout changes, cabinet replacement, island redesign, and projects that require several trades to work in a precise sequence.

Explore service

Bathroom Remodeling

The service covers complete primary and guest bathroom renovations, layout changes, accessibility improvements, and replacement of outdated or failing assemblies.

Explore service

The service covers detached and attached ADUs, qualifying garage conversions, and compact living spaces intended for family, guests, work, or rental use.

Explore service

Regional context

Local conditions that shape planning and construction.

Operating model

Address and scope are reviewed first so site visits, design coordination, estimating, and construction planning can be sequenced around the correct jurisdiction and property conditions.

Available services

All ten service lines are available for qualifying Seattle and Eastside homes, from focused painting and flooring work to additions, ADUs, and full-home transformations.

Climate

Rain, moisture, drainage, shaded exposures, and seasonal drying conditions affect exterior assemblies, material storage, ventilation, and construction sequencing.

Permitting context

Seattle, Redmond, Bellevue, and surrounding jurisdictions use different zoning, plan-review, inspection, and documentation processes. The applicable pathway is confirmed by address.

Housing conditions

The region includes mid-century homes, older urban houses, newer infill, sloped sites, and remodeled properties where concealed transitions deserve early investigation.

Qualification guidance

Share the property address, desired scope, daily-use concerns, investment range, and target timing. Photos or existing plans can help but are not required for the first conversation.

Design gallery

Ideas for homes in Seattle & the Eastside

Explore service-focused design ideas, materials, and planning considerations, then adapt them to the actual property and regional conditions.

Whole-Home Design Ideas

A whole-home renovation works best when circulation, structure, lighting, storage, and finish selections are considered as one system. These ideas show how individual rooms can share a consistent architectural language without becoming repetitive.

Explore the gallery

Kitchen Design Ideas

The strongest kitchens balance work zones, circulation, storage, daylight, task lighting, and materials that can handle daily use. This gallery focuses on combinations that feel refined without sacrificing function.

Explore the gallery

Bathroom Design Ideas

A refined bathroom depends on careful relationships between waterproofing, drainage, tile, fixtures, ventilation, lighting, storage, and clearances. These ideas keep performance and comfort at the center.

Explore the gallery

ADU Design Ideas

A successful ADU makes limited area feel deliberate. These ideas explore compact planning, daylight, privacy, storage, utilities, access, and a respectful relationship to the primary home.

Explore the gallery

Market questions

Seattle & the Eastside service FAQs

Which Seattle and Eastside communities are eligible?

Eligibility is confirmed by address, service, scope, schedule, and current capacity. Submit the ZIP code for a direct response.

Can RT coordinate permit responsibilities?

Yes. The scope identifies the required design, engineering, submittal, correction, inspection, and homeowner responsibilities for the applicable jurisdiction.

Can work be planned around an occupied home?

Many projects can be planned around occupancy. Utilities, dust control, access, safety, sequencing, and temporary facilities determine what is practical.

Start a practical conversation

Discuss a qualifying Seattle & the Eastside project.

Share the ZIP code, service, scope, desired timing, and what is driving the project. The first response will focus on fit and the next useful step.
